subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become the permanent extension-facing channel capability for captioned final-mode TTS delivery?
rationale: The capability fits the repository's typed plugin-boundary architecture, but it deliberately expands the public channel SDK and lets plugins opt into text-suppression semantics that can lose messages if declared incorrectly.

options.title: Accept the generic capability
options.body: Adopt `captionedFinalText` as the SDK contract, but require the missing dispatcher observer, compatibility tests, green checks, and exact-head Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the behavior Telegram-owned
options.body: Remove the public SDK addition and implement a narrower Telegram-owned delivery path, accepting less reuse for other caption-capable channels.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Hold or close this PR until maintainers decide whether bundled captions or the separate-delivery behavior tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42539 should be the product default.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic capability
recommendation.body: Adopt `captionedFinalText` as the SDK contract, but require the missing dispatcher observer, compatibility tests, green checks, and exact-head Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history spans the ACP dispatch, generic reply delivery, plugin SDK boundary, and Telegram capability surfaces needed to decide the permanent contract.
